Design ready for reuse (so a successor skips orientation): one full-file Write of the module. F1 first pass over argv[start+1..] on a PowerShell carrier with regex ^(--|-|/)([A-Za-z]+)([:=].*)?$ and name e, ec or a prefix of encodedcommand (do NOT include -ea in this pass; -ea is -ErrorAction and would over-refuse inside -Command text). F7 peel ^--?[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:(.+)$ in variantsOf. F6 sh-syntax variant text.replace(/\\([\s\S]?)/g,'$1') in checkCandidates. cwd tracked as ctx.cwd/ctx.cwd0, used for root matching only (never for the exact secretBasenames check, which needs a directory component), cd segment applied after scanArgv in scanText, scanPieces uses the initial cwd. F3 patterns applied per argv token in scanArgv (never in scanPieces), skipping indices a carrier hands to a nested scan (-c text, node -e source, PowerShell command text, wsl pass-through, cmd /c tail), with the rg/grep/git grep/Select-String pattern-position exclusion implemented per Ruling 106 (two-pass: find pattern-supplying options first, then exclude the first positional only if none). Only genuinely value-taking flags may be listed as valued per tool (rg -r/-E/-d take values, grep -r/-E do not); a boolean mis-listed as valued would UNDER-refuse. F2 exemptScripts: exact, case-sensitive, normalised repo-relative match in readOperand, only when no cd moved the cwd. F5 node: preload values and attached --require=/--import=/--loader= forms read, every positional read unless -e/-p was seen; wrappers seek forward to first carrier token.

Wiring note (not a defect of this slice): with EVERY node file operand read, a real readScript that returns null for non-file operands (for example the --out value and the literal 'node' in the capture-evidence route) will refuse; N3-1 stays green only because the fake reader falls back to a benign script.
No stop condition 1-5 triggered by repo reality; the stop is the input-contract refusal of an unauthenticated rules/DoD change.
